delivery_issue.description: A package is late, delayed, missing, or has not arrived within the expected delivery time.
examples: My package has not arrived yet
My delivery is several days late
My package was supposed to arrive today but it hasn't
My order has not been delivered
The delivery is taking too long
Why is my package delayed?
It has been days and my order still hasn't arrived
My order is late

order_tracking_status.description: The customer wants information about the current location, tracking, or shipment status of an order.
examples: Where is my order?
Can you tell me the status of my shipment?
I want to track my order
What is the current status of my package?
Can you give me an update on my order?
Where is my package right now?
The tracking information has not updated
Can you check the shipment status?

return_issue.description: Problems or questions about returning a product, arranging a return, or scheduling a return pickup.
examples: I want to return this product
How can I return my order?
How can I arrange a return pickup?
My return pickup has not happened
I started a return but there is a problem
I need to send this item back
The courier has not collected my return
There is a problem with my return

refund_issue.description: Problems involving a missing, delayed, pending, incorrect, or incomplete refund.
examples: I have not received my refund
My refund is still pending
Why is my refund delayed?
I cancelled my order but did not get my refund
Where is my refund?
The refund amount is incorrect
I was promised a refund but haven't received it
My money has not been refunded

cancellation.description: Requests or problems related to cancelling an order or an order being cancelled.
examples: I want to cancel my order
Can I cancel this order?
Please cancel my order
Amazon cancelled my order
My order was cancelled
Why was my order cancelled?
I need to cancel this shipment
Can I cancel the order before it is delivered?

payment_billing.description: Payment failures, duplicate charges, billing problems, payment methods, or payment options.
examples: My payment failed
I was charged twice
Why was my card declined?
My payment was rejected
There is an extra charge on my account
Can I pay using EMI?
I cannot update my payment method
Why did Amazon charge me?

account_login.description: Problems with account access, login, account security, or account-related access issues.
examples: I cannot log into my Amazon account
I cannot access my account
I forgot my account login
I am unable to sign in
There is an unknown device on my account

prime.description: Questions or problems specifically related to Amazon Prime membership, Prime benefits, Prime Video, or Prime services.
examples: My Prime delivery is late
Why is my Prime order not arriving?
I cannot watch Prime Video
My Prime trial is expiring
How does Amazon Prime work?

What are the benefits of Prime?

promotion_discount.description: Problems with promotional credits, coupons, discounts, cashback, offers, or promotional benefits.
examples: I did not receive my promotional credit
My coupon is not working
Where is my cashback?
Why can't I apply this promotion?
I did not receive my promotional offer
My discount was not applied
Where is my promotional credit?
The offer is not working

product_device_issue.description: Problems with a physical product or device, including damaged, defective, or malfunctioning products.
examples: The product I received is damaged
My replacement arrived damaged
The device is not working
I received a defective product
The item arrived broken
My Amazon device is not working
The product stopped working
I received a damaged item

delivery_misdelivery.description: A package was delivered to the wrong person, wrong location, unsafe location, or marked as delivered when the customer did not receive it.
examples: My package was delivered to the wrong address
The package was delivered to someone else
My order was delivered to the wrong location
The courier left my package somewhere unsafe
My package says delivered but I did not receive it
The delivery person left my package outside
My package was delivered to the wrong person
It says delivered but my package is missing

security_fraud.description: Suspicious, fraudulent, phishing, impersonation, or unauthorized Amazon-related messages and account security concerns.
examples: I received a fraudulent Amazon confirmation email

I received a suspicious email from someone claiming to be Amazon
I think this Amazon email is a scam
I received a fake order confirmation
Someone is trying to impersonate Amazon
I received a suspicious message about my Amazon order
How do I report a fraudulent Amazon email?

general_amazon_query.description: General questions about Amazon products, services, availability, regions, website functionality, or policies that do not fit another specific support intent.
examples: Can I use Cash on Delivery in my area?
Will this product be available on Amazon Germany?
Can I buy this product from Amazon?
Is this service available in my country?
Why can't I view products on the Amazon website?
Can I use Amazon services in another country?
Is this product available on Amazon?
I have a general question about Amazon

general_unclear.description: The customer message does not contain enough information to reliably determine the issue.
examples: I need help
Can someone help me?
I have a problem with Amazon
What is going on?
Please help me
I need assistance
Can you help?
I have an issue
